sloka: स त्वं हत्वा मधुसुतं लवणं पापनिश्चयम् ।राज्यं प्रशाधि धर्मेण वाक्यं मे यद्यवेक्षसे ।। ७.६२.१९ ॥
transliteration: sa tvaṁ hatvā madhusutaṁ lavaṇaṁ pāpaniścayam ।rājyaṁ praśādhi dharmeṇa vākyaṁ me yadyavekṣase ।। 7.62.19 ॥

translations.english: If you respect my words, then you, having killed Lavana, the evil-minded son of Madhu, should rule the kingdom righteously.
